_comment: PhantomNet Sprint Config — Week 21 (Month 6 Week 1: Advanced Features & Edge Cases, Days 41-45)
milestone_description: Advanced features, CVE mapping, audit logging, system hardening, comprehensive E2E testing, and final V3.0 production delivery.

tasks.Title: Playbook Comparison View Backend API
tasks.Objective: Implement side-by-side playbook comparison endpoint to compare playbooks generated for different campaigns or techniques.
Tasks: Create GET /api/v1/sentinel/playbooks/compare endpoint.
Compare attack techniques, IOC counts, confidence scores, and rule differences.
Return structured diff data for frontend rendering.
Deliverables: Unit tests for comparison endpoint in tests/test_sentinel_compare.py.

tasks.Title: CVE Mapping Engine for Threat Patterns
tasks.Objective: Map detected honeypot attack patterns (SQLi, Path Traversal, SSH Brute Force, Command Injection) to relevant CVE references.
Tasks: Create CVE mapping dictionary in backend/sentinel/cve_mapper.py.
Enrich SentinelPlaybook generation pipeline with matching CVE IDs.
Include CVE external references in STIX 2.1 bundles.

tasks.Title: Playbook Quality Scoring Engine
tasks.Objective: Implement dynamic quality scoring (0-100) based on IOC count, cluster volume, model confidence, and multi-source verification.
Tasks: Create quality scoring function in backend/sentinel/quality_scorer.py.
Add quality_score column to SentinelPlaybook model.
Expose quality badge metadata in playbook API responses.

tasks.Title: Dark and Light Theme Consistency Verification
tasks.Objective: Verify and fix all Sentinel UI components to ensure CSS variables seamlessly inherit dark/light theme context.
Tasks: Audit all Sentinel CSS classes and inline styles.
Replace hardcoded color values with theme variable tokens.
Verify dark/light toggle across Sentinel Dashboard and Playbook Viewer.
Deliverables: Theme-compliant CSS updates in src/pages/SentinelDashboard.jsx and PlaybookViewer.

tasks.Title: Webhook Notification System for Critical Incidents
tasks.Objective: Implement webhook dispatcher to send HTTP POST notifications to configured SOC webhooks on CRITICAL playbook generation.
Tasks: Add webhook_url configuration to system config schema.
Build asynchronous webhook notification sender with retry logic.
Trigger webhook payload containing playbook summary and STIX alert on CRITICAL severities.

tasks.Title: Combined IDS Rules ZIP Package Export
tasks.Objective: Implement endpoint allowing analysts to download all active approved Snort and Sigma rules packaged as a single ZIP archive.
Tasks: Create GET /api/v1/sentinel/rules/export-all endpoint.
Bundle Snort (.rules) and Sigma (.yml) files into a ZIP stream.
Include README metadata inside the exported archive.
Deliverables: Combined rule export API endpoint in backend/api/sentinel.py.

tasks.Title: Campaign Timeline Time-Series Data API
tasks.Objective: Expose time-series attack event density and cluster progression per campaign for visualization.
Tasks: Create GET /api/v1/sentinel/campaigns/{id}/timeline endpoint.
Aggregate honeypot packet events into hourly/daily buckets.
Return JSON payload structured for frontend charting libraries.
Deliverables: Campaign timeline API endpoint in backend/api/sentinel.py.

tasks.Title: Campaign Timeline Density Chart in Playbook Viewer
tasks.Objective: Build interactive attack event density line chart inside PlaybookViewer showing progression over campaign duration.
Tasks: Integrate chart component (recharts/chart.js) in PlaybookViewer.
Fetch campaign time-series data from backend API.
Render hover tooltips for attack spikes and anomaly timestamps.

tasks.Title: Sentinel Audit Logging System
tasks.Objective: Record detailed audit logs for all analyst actions (approval, rejection, regeneration, export, batch operations).
Tasks: Create SentinelAuditLog DB model in backend/sentinel/models.py.
Implement audit logging middleware/helper.
Expose GET /api/v1/sentinel/audit-logs endpoint for compliance tracking.
Deliverables: Audit log DB model and API endpoints in backend/sentinel/models.py and backend/api/sentinel.py.

tasks.Title: Snort and Sigma Rule Deduplication Engine
tasks.Objective: Implement rule deduplication to eliminate duplicate detection rules across multiple playbooks targeting identical IP/port/signature patterns.
Tasks: Add hash fingerprinting for Snort and Sigma rules.
Filter out duplicate rules during auto-generation and compilation.
Update rule generator tests to verify deduplication behavior.

tasks.Title: Playbook Jinja2 Template Preview API
tasks.Objective: Build template preview and inspection API allowing SOC leads to test and render templates with sample payloads.
Tasks: Create GET /api/v1/sentinel/templates and POST /api/v1/sentinel/templates/preview endpoints.
Support live parameter injection for testing Jinja2 syntax.
Return rendered Markdown preview and syntax validation status.
Deliverables: Template inspection API endpoints in backend/api/sentinel.py.

tasks.Title: Playbook Export History Tracking UI
tasks.Objective: Add export history log panel in PlaybookViewer displaying when, by whom, and in what format (PDF/STIX/ZIP/JSON) playbooks were exported.
Tasks: Fetch export audit logs from backend audit endpoint.
Display export activity timeline in PlaybookViewer drawer/modal.
Provide quick re-download links for previous exports.

tasks.Title: Sentinel Generation API Rate Limiting
tasks.Objective: Protect backend resources by enforcing rate limits on manual playbook generation and LLM narrative requests.
Tasks: Implement rate-limiting middleware (max 10 manual generations/hr).
Return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with retry headers on limit breaches.
Add rate limit status indicators to health endpoints.

tasks.Title: IDS Rule Quality & Syntax Validation Pass
tasks.Objective: Perform automated syntax validation against generated Snort 2.9/3.0 and Sigma YML specifications.
Tasks: Validate Snort rules using snort -T or python snort parser.
Validate Sigma rules using pySigma validator.
Add strict schema validation to rule generation build pipeline.
Deliverables: Rule syntax validator script verify_rule_generator.py updates.

tasks.Title: Automated Playbook Archive & Retention Cleanup
tasks.Objective: Implement automated lifecycle retention service to archive and purge rejected or obsolete playbooks based on configurable policies.
Tasks: Add background cleanup task to background scheduler.
Support policy config (e.g., auto-archive rejected > 30 days).
Maintain audit trail of purged playbooks.

tasks.Title: Tablet and Mobile Responsive Viewport Pass
tasks.Objective: Ensure Sentinel Dashboard, Playbook Viewer, and Mitre Matrix render cleanly on tablet and mobile resolutions.
Tasks: Test viewport breakpoints (768px, 1024px, 1280px).
Adjust table scrollbars, flex layouts, and matrix font scaling.
Fix touch interactions for playbook action buttons.
Deliverables: Responsive layout fixes across Sentinel frontend pages.

tasks.Title: Week 21 Review and Formal Feature Freeze Sign-off
tasks.Objective: Conduct final review of Week 21 deliverables, merge code, tag feature freeze milestone, and finalize Phase 7 planning.
Tasks: Perform code review on all Week 21 PRs.
Formalize feature freeze for Sentinel V3.1.
Document Month 6 Week 1 progress and Phase 7 roadmap status.

tasks.Title: Security Audit of Week 21 Endpoints
tasks.Objective: Audit new Week 21 endpoints (comparison, webhooks, ZIP export, audit logs) for authorization and input injection vulnerabilities.
Tasks: Verify BOLA / IDOR checks on compare and audit log endpoints.
Test webhook URL validation to prevent Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).
Sanitize rule export paths to prevent zip slip vulnerabilities.
Deliverables: Security audit findings report for Week 21 endpoints.

tasks.Title: Timeline Data and Quality Scoring Stress Test
tasks.Objective: Benchmark quality scoring calculation and time-series aggregation endpoints under high payload volumes.
Tasks: Simulate 1,000+ playbook records for quality scoring benchmarks.
Benchmark timeline API latency with 10,000+ packet logs.
Optimize SQL queries and indexing for campaign timeline retrieval.
Deliverables: Performance benchmark report for scoring and timeline APIs.

tasks.Title: End-to-End Sentinel V3.1 UI Verification
tasks.Objective: Perform end-to-end verification of all Sentinel UI features including compare modal, timeline chart, export history, and dark theme.
Tasks: Validate full analyst workflow in Sentinel Dashboard.
Verify compare modal diff highlights.
Verify timeline chart interactivity and export history drawer.
Deliverables: UI verification sign-off and E2E test report.
